stem: A mother says her infant vomited after a routine immunisation and asks which vaccine in the routine infant schedule is given orally. Which vaccine was it?
explanation: Rotavirus vaccine is administered orally in infancy. Hib, pneumococcal, varicella and pertussis-containing vaccines are not the routine oral vaccine in this context.
